answer_1.quote: In this paper, we introduce TOME, a innovative two-stage model-based retrieval approach. To implement our approach, we make two major technical contributions in the design of the identifier and the architecture of two-stage generation.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates passages and URLs based on input queries, with the final output being the URL of the relevant document.

answer_2.quote: Following previous works, we adopt Hits@1 as the evaluation metric. This metric is calculated as the percentage of queries to which the top-1 generation result is positive.
